text:
Samira Patel: Hey team — first week and my dock arrived but the USB ports aren't recognizing my mouse or keyboard. Monitors are fine, but USB devices don't show up. Who should I ping for a quick swap or troubleshooting?

Alex Li: @Samira Patel welcome! pinging IT — can you try a quick power-cycle of the dock first? unplug the dock power and USB-C to laptop for 30s then reconnect. Also which OS are you on? Windows/Mac/Linux?

Samira Patel: I'm on MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma). Did the power-cycle, still nothing. Keyboard backlight turns on but keystrokes not registering. Trackpad works over BT so not totally blocked.

Alex Li: Got it. Can you open Terminal and run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the USB section? if you prefer, take a quick photo of the Thunderbolt cable connectors and the dock model (label on bottom).

Samira Patel: Pasted the USB output: ```
USB Device Tree:
    (no USB devices found)
```  — that's why I thought it's dead. Dock model on sticker: "DockPro X2".

Alex Li: Thanks. That output is suspicious. I'm going to file a ticket and request a replacement dock to be shipped ASAP. Can you confirm your desk location (building + floor) for shipping?

Samira Patel: Building B, 3rd floor, desk B3-12. Thanks!

it-bot: New ticket created: IT-4721 — "DockPro X2 USB ports not recognized". Assigned to Alex Li. ETA for replacement shipment: 48 hours.

Jordan Reyes: @Samira Patel I can drop a spare DockPro X1 by your desk tomorrow morning if you want a faster swap — saves shipping. It's been tested and available in stock.

Samira Patel: That would be amazing, @Jordan Reyes — thank you! Tomorrow morning works.

Alex Li: Great — I'll mark IT-4721 as pending replacement and add the swapping instructions. If the X1 works, we'll close the ticket and log the X2 for RMA. Quick note for future debugging: sometimes macOS blocks USB due to kernel extensions — but your `system_profiler` showing none suggests hardware failure.

Priya Gomez: Welcome onboard, Samira! If you need any onboarding checklist items completed (badge, access, Slack groups), DM me. Glad this was a quick catch. :tada:

Jordan Reyes: Dropping by 9:30am with DockPro X1 (asset AT-3342). I'll leave a sticky note with my name in case you're in a meeting.

Samira Patel: Confirmed — Jordan stopped by and swapped the dock, and now keyboard + mouse detected immediately. Everything looks normal. Thanks everyone!

Alex Li: Excellent. Marking IT-4721 resolved: replaced faulty DockPro X2 (RMA logged), installed DockPro X1 (asset AT-3342) as swap. Samira — if anything flakey in the next 48h ping me and we'll escalate firmware. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark: 

it-bot: Ticket IT-4721 status changed to RESOLVED by Alex Li on 1769123720.
